_about: Phase 1 basics writer (learn/ml-basics-recap, learn/serving-metrics). TTFT, TPOT, ITL and goodput are in core.json.

e2e-latency.short: End-to-end latency. The time from the arrival of a request to its last output token.
e2e-latency.long: vLLM measures it in the front end from arrival_time ({{cite vllm/v1/metrics/stats.py:594}}). vllm bench serve measures it at the client and calls it E2EL.

request-throughput.short: The number of finished requests per second, over the whole run.

token-throughput.short: The number of tokens per second that a server makes (output tokens), or reads and makes (input plus output tokens).

concurrency.short: The number of requests in the server at the same time. More concurrency gives bigger batches and more throughput, but each step takes longer.

slo.short: Service level objective. A limit that a request must meet to count as good, for example TTFT of 500 ms or less.

percentile.short: The value that a given part of the samples is below. p50 (the median): half of the samples are below it. p99: 99 % are below it.

prometheus-histogram.short: A Prometheus metric that counts samples in fixed buckets. It has the series _bucket, _sum and _count. Percentiles from it are estimates.
prometheus-histogram.long: vLLM takes the default bucket edges from vllm/v1/metrics/buckets.py ({{cite vllm/v1/metrics/buckets.py:30-104}}).
